content.text: I changed one file, `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (2 tests). The bug was in how the parser handles escaped quotes inside a quoted field. In CSV, two double quotes in a row (`""`) stand for one literal `"`. The check that looks at the character after a quote was comparing it to a single quote (`"'"`) instead of a double quote (`'"'`). Because of that, the first `"` of every `""` pair was read as the end of the field, and the parser then raised "character after closing quote." I changed that comparison to look for a double quote, so `""` now becomes one `"` and the field keeps going. Nothing else changed, and the public `parse_csv_line` API is the same.

Because of that, the first `"` of every `""` pair was read as the end of the field, and the parser then raised "character after closing quote." I changed that comparison to look for a double quote, so `""` now becomes one `"` and the field keeps going. Nothing else changed, and the public `parse_csv_line` API is the same.
